RANKED.label: Ranked
RANKED.rules: Fight the saved team of a player near your rating. Rating and rank change; they don't have to be online.

BALANCED.label: Balanced League
BALANCED.rules: Team power (ATK + DEF + HP) cannot exceed {mult}× the average card power.

C / C++.name: Raw Power
C / C++.desc: Attacks ignore {defIgnored} of the opponent's DEF.

C#.name: Critical Hit
C#.desc: Each turn: {chance} chance to land a Critical Hit for {critMult, number}x damage.

CSS.name: Undefined Behavior
CSS.desc: Each turn: {doubleChance} chance to deal Double Damage; otherwise {zeroChance} chance to deal exactly 0 damage (rarer cards misbehave less).

Dart.name: Hot Reload
Dart.desc: Once per battle, when its HP drops below {hpThreshold}, instantly restores {heal} of its max HP.

Go.name: First Strike
Go.desc: Deals one hit to the opposing card as soon as it enters the field (blocked by Iron Shield).

HTML.name: Graceful Degradation
HTML.desc: While below {hpThreshold} HP, takes {damageReduction} less damage. Browsers render it anyway.

Java.name: JIT Warm-up
Java.desc: Slow start: deals {firstTurnPenalty} less damage on its first turn of each matchup, then +{perTurn} per turn, up to +{maxBonus}.

JavaScript.name: Double Callback
JavaScript.desc: Each turn: {chance} chance to hit again, dealing {damageMult, number}x damage that turn.

Jupyter Notebook.name: Interactive Kernel
Jupyter Notebook.desc: Heals {regen} of its ATK at the end of every turn it survives, and counts as a Python card for the Python Synergy.

Kotlin.name: Null Safety
Kotlin.desc: Never loses more than {maxHpPct} of its max HP in a single turn.

PHP.name: @ Error Suppression
PHP.desc: Once per battle, a hit that would knock it out leaves it at {hp} HP instead.

Python.name: Regeneration
Python.desc: At the end of every turn it survives, heals for HP equal to {regen} of its ATK.

Ruby.name: Last Stand
Ruby.desc: While its HP is below {hpThreshold}, deals {atkMult, number}x damage.

Rust.name: Iron Shield
Rust.desc: Enters the field with a shield that blocks all damage of its first turn (including a Go First Strike).

Shell.name: Cron Job
Shell.desc: Every {every, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}} turn of a matchup its attack runs twice ({mult, number}x damage).

Swift.name: Dodge
Swift.desc: Each turn: {chance} chance to dodge the opponent's attack completely.

TypeScript.name: Type Safety
TypeScript.desc: Passively reduces all incoming damage by {reduction}.

C.desc: Attacks ignore {defIgnored} of the opponent's DEF.

C++.name: Raw Power
C++.desc: Attacks ignore {defIgnored} of the opponent's DEF.

C#.name: Critical Hit
C#.desc: {chance} chance per turn to crit for {critMult, number}x damage.

CSS.name: Undefined Behavior
CSS.desc: Each turn: {doubleChance} to deal 2x, {zeroChance} to deal 0.

neutral.name: Neutral
neutral.desc: No combat passive and no type matchups.
